# vendor/

Third-party files, served as-is. Copied into `build/` by `build.sh`.

- `list.min.js` — [List.js](https://listjs.com) 2.3.1 by Jonny Strömberg, MIT license. Same file as bjornpaedia’s `vendor/list.min.js` (and byte-identical to cdnjs’s `list.js/2.3.1/list.min.js`). Powers search and sorting on `works.html`; the page works without it.
